common.orphan_exit: counterpart >=2c behind current touch, otherwise TTL60
common.fill_queue_ahead: current displayed quantity at exact quote level only
common.fill_test: strict trade-through: cumulative eligible taker volume > ahead+clip
common.tick_rule: <10c or >90c: 0.1c; otherwise: 1c; apply sequentially from current price
common.post_only: candidate bid must be strictly below corresponding current ask

arms.P0_TOUCH: quote both current touches; no 60s-support requirement
arms.P1_SHIFT1: require complete60s and finite two-sided touch ETA; improve slower touch leg one legal tick and retreat faster leg one legal tick
arms.P2_SHIFT2: same as P1, two sequential legal ticks on each leg
arms.P3_SPEND1: require P1 support; if pair slack funds a legal one-tick slower-leg improvement, keep fast leg unchanged; otherwise use P1_SHIFT1
arms.P4_ETA_ENUM1: enumerate each leg {-1,0,+1} legal tick; require post-only and sum<=99c; predicted ETA numerator=all displayed barrier depth at prices better than candidate + same-price ahead + clip; denominator=past60 executable taker flow to candidate/60; minimize max ETA, then pair sum, then abs(log ETAy-log ETAn), then lexicographic (yes_e4,no_e4)

spec.support_rule: P1-P4 SKIP without complete60s and finite positive two-sided ETA support
spec.slower_tie_rule: YES is the slower leg when touch ETA is exactly tied
spec.selection_gate: cycles>=30, markets>=10, completion Wilson LCB95>break-even completion, market-cluster bootstrap CI95 lower>0
